Text: Carries water one way along the arrow, level or downhill.
A covered flume. A path can be built on top.
A Flume Bridge piece that stands over another flume.
A flume one block up on a trestle. Water and walkers pass under it.
The start of a flume. Sets how much water goes in, and closes against badwater.
Turns a flume. Flumes enter and leave through its two open sides.
Holds the field in front at a set shallow depth.
Stands in a current and lifts water two levels onto the bank behind it.
A worker walks the wheel and lifts water from the pit behind it to a ledge.
A mill driven by the current it stands in, with no shafts.
A worker pours stored Water into the water in front.
Collects a trickle of Water from the air, with no workers.
